description: This file declares functions, classes, and templates related to creating constant operations ('Const') in TensorFlow's C++ API. It defines interfaces to generate constant tensors, convert them, and handle node outputs within the TensorFlow graph construction process.

methods.name: Output Const(const Scope & scope,const Input::Initializer & val)
methods.description: Creates a constant tensor operation in the TensorFlow graph from a given scope and initializer value.

methods.name: ConstFromProto
methods.description: Creates a constant tensor from a proto within a given scope.

methods.name: AsNodeOut
methods.description: Converts an input to a node output within a scope.

methods.name: Const (template)
methods.description: Creates a constant tensor with a specific value and shape.

methods.name: Const (template with initializer list)
methods.description: Creates a constant tensor from an initializer list and shape.

methods.name: AsNodeOutList
methods.description: Converts an input list to a vector of node outputs within a scope.

methods.name: Output Const(const Scope & scope,const T & v,const TensorShape shape)
Output Const(const Scope & scope,const std::initializer_list<T> & v,const TensorShape shape)
